sourceRefs.locator: Opening paragraphs locate the Tabriz foundation and date the endowment deed to 9 August 1309. The surviving ruins give the approximate quarter.
Opening discussion of the endowment document and its later appendix. Paper, goatskin binding, checks, Arabic and Persian copies and loans of exemplars.

note.de: 1309 regelte Raschid ad-Din den Betrieb seiner Stiftung bei Täbris. Ein späterer Nachtrag legte die zweisprachige Vervielfältigung eigener Werke fest. Der Punkt zeigt das Stiftungsviertel.
note.en: Rashid al-Din recorded the workings of his Tabriz foundation in 1309. A later appendix provided for copying his works in two languages. The point marks the foundation quarter.
